## apiome projects {#projects}

List and fetch tenant projects.

```text
apiome projects [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Subcommands: [`get`](#projects-get), [`list`](#projects-list).

## apiome projects get {#projects-get}

Fetch one project by id (GET /v1/projects/{tenant_slug}/{project_id}).

```text
apiome projects get [OPTIONS] PROJECT_ID
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PROJECT_ID` | uuid | yes | Project UUID. |

## apiome projects list {#projects-list}

List projects (GET /v1/projects/{tenant_slug}).

```text
apiome projects list [OPTIONS]
```
